verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own MCP integration with a dedicated setup guide. It lets a user connect their Puzzle account directly to Claude to reach financial data conversationally, so Puzzle acts as an official MCP server for an agent. Missing for 10: details of the exposed tools/resources and their scope (read vs. write), auth and transport details, documented support for agents other than Claude, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Puzzle's MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration lets you connect your Puzzle account directly to Claude, giving you instant access to your financial data through natural conversation
